classification_dependency.failure_behavior: Binance spot discovery raises; the caller retains the last complete catalog. No incomplete stock classification is accepted.
classification_dependency.required_coverage: Every active USDT spot product from exchangeInfo must have matching symbol/base/quote metadata.
